# bus#14070 新分 5 张 test 收口 · 审核排队与回执方式

## 背景

又初经 bus 提交 **#14070**（`bus#13883/#13918` 新分 5 张：周月活跃 + 三维表 test 收口）。知秋在协作群确认欠审材料现在开始审；同期生产调度器停机事故占用排期，审核在事故处理之后进行。

## 坑 / 错误做法

- 仅在群里 @ 催审、不等 bus 逐条结论就当审结
- 事故与审核窗口内又初自行接新单或改 prod 编排
- 订单认 `_r` 口径未附 `口径差说明.md` 就要求狂人拍板

## 正确做法

- 审结与 PASS/HOLD **以 agent-bus 逐条回执为准**；群消息是状态镜像，不替代 bus 结案
- 审核排队：生产事故优先 → 再处理 #14070；又初 **停手待命**，不接新单、不动生产
- 订单 `_r` 相关条目：审核人须先读会话目录内 **`口径差说明.md`** 再定稿
- 与分工一致：七步影子 + 7 日对平；周月首版 `_uc`；平台 API 化上线前 prod 不挂不切（见 MEMORY_OPEN `bus#13883`）

## 验证

- inbox 收到 bus#14070 子项逐条 reply / progress
- 事故解除前无又初侧 prod 挂步或新 bus 认领

## 关联

- `.cursor/rules/agent-bus-session.mdc`
- `lessons/2026-09-08-审稿须带对象-群消息不进狂人任务队列.md`
- MEMORY_OPEN · `bus#13883/#13918`

mcpDetails.description: Week self-check: w_uc vs daily bitmap union per app

arguments.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT app_code,
         bm_merge(active_users) AS au,
         bm_merge(new_users) AS nu
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_user_d_h_uc
  WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-11-02' AND '2026-11-05'
  GROUP BY app_code
),
w AS (
  SELECT app_code,
         bm_merge(active_users) AS au,
         bm_merge(new_users) AS nu
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_user_w_d_new_uc
  WHERE `week` = '2026045'
  GROUP BY app_code
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS apps_compared,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bm_count(d.au)=bm_count(w.au) AND bm_count(d.nu)=bm_count(w.nu) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS apps_equal,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bm_count(d.au)<>bm_count(w.au) OR bm_count(d.nu)<>bm_count(w.nu) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS apps_diff,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.app_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.app_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_daily,
  MAX(ABS(bm_count(COALESCE(w.au, bm_empty())) - bm_count(COALESCE(d.au, bm_empty())))) AS max_abs_au_diff,
  MAX(ABS(bm_count(COALESCE(w.nu, bm_empty())) - bm_count(COALESCE(d.nu, bm_empty())))) AS max_abs_nu_diff
FROM daily d
FULL OUTER JOIN w ON d.app_code = w.app_code
